7.7.2 Initialization of PduRRoutingPathGroups
[SWS_PduR_00892]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06120
⌈A PduRRoutingPath shall be disabled, if all PduRRoutingPathGroups it refer-
ences are disabled.⌋
[SWS_PduR_00894]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06120
⌈All PduRRoutingPathGroups where PduRIsEnabledAtInit is set to TRUE shall
be enabled after initialization of the PDU Router module.⌋
[SWS_PduR_00895]
Upstream requirements: SRS_GTW_06120
⌈All PduRRoutingPathGroups where PduRIsEnabledAtInit is set to FALSE
shall be disabled.⌋
